attack.content:
STATE_ID: attack
LOOP_TYPE: cyclic
ROOT: in-place; torso may brace downward by a small fixed amplitude; zero horizontal travel or drift
CONTACTS: both mechanical feet remain planted and never slide throughout the strike and recovery
START_END_POSE: neutral combat guard with both oversized hammer-palms low beside the legs, shoulders level, knees slightly flexed, torso upright
PHASE_00: exact neutral guard
PHASE_25: both hammer-arms draw backward together while knees and shoulder pistons compress slightly
PHASE_50: both hammer-palms swing forward and downward together into one symmetrical impact pose; torso braces without stepping
PHASE_75: both arms recoil upward and backward together while the torso rises toward guard
PHASE_100: exact PHASE_00
TRAJECTORIES: both hammer-palms follow matching forward-down impact arcs and matching recovery arcs; shoulder plates and forearm mass lag subtly; legs remain fixed; three amber lenses remain fixed to the chest
AMPLITUDE: large synchronized arm swing, small knee compression, small torso brace, no locomotion
TIMING: quick anticipation, decisive midpoint impact, smooth recovery; two identical complete strike cycles over the backend's four-second source so the first two seconds contain exactly one complete strike and recovery
PERSISTENCE: ceramic shell, all limbs, joints, brass fittings, chest lenses, feet, and hammer-palms remain present and structurally consistent throughout
FORBIDDEN: alternating arms, single-arm strike, walking, turn, jump, extra strike, foot lift, foot sliding, body rotation, camera-relative choreography, morphing, missing or appearing parts

walk.content:
STATE_ID: walk
LOOP_TYPE: cyclic
ROOT: in-place; torso may bob vertically by a small fixed amplitude; zero horizontal travel or drift
CONTACTS: alternating mechanical feet; the planted foot never slides; each foot completes one lift, swing, and plant cycle
START_END_POSE: anatomical right foot planted, anatomical left foot passing forward, anatomical right arm back and anatomical left arm forward; same torso height and limb phase
PHASE_00: right foot planted, left foot passing forward, right hammer-arm back, left hammer-arm forward
PHASE_25: double-support transition with torso at its lowest point
PHASE_50: left foot planted, right foot passing forward, hammer-arm swing reversed
PHASE_75: double-support transition with torso at its lowest point
PHASE_100: exact PHASE_00
TRAJECTORIES: legs alternate evenly; oversized hammer-palms counter-swing with restrained mechanical inertia; shoulder plates lag subtly; three amber lenses remain fixed to the chest
AMPLITUDE: medium leg swing, small torso bob, small shoulder and hammer-palm lag
TIMING: even cadence, no acceleration; two identical complete gait cycles over the backend's four-second source so the first two seconds contain exactly one complete cycle
PERSISTENCE: ceramic shell, all limbs, joints, brass fittings, chest lenses, feet, and hammer-palms remain present and structurally consistent throughout
FORBIDDEN: travel, turn, jump, crouch, attack, wave, both arms swinging together, extra step, foot sliding, body rotation, camera-relative choreography, morphing, missing or appearing parts

requests.canonical_reproduction_prompt:
OPERATION: Edit only the pose of the supplied North-East attack guard into the requested locked attack phase; retain exact identity, facing, camera, framing, background, and style.
IDENTITY_LOCK: Preserve the supplied chibi robot grunt identity: ivory cracked ceramic shell, dark metal skeleton and joints, brass fittings, three vertical amber chest lenses, oversized rectangular hammer-palms, compact armored legs, painterly tactical-game rendering. Static orthographic/isometric camera, flat neutral lighting, uniform #D3D3D3 background, full body in frame, no floor shadow, no text, no extra objects.
DIRECTION_LOCK: North-East back-right three-quarter isometric facing; rear silhouette readable.
ACTION_CONTRACT:
STATE_ID: attack
LOOP_TYPE: cyclic
ROOT: in-place; torso may brace downward by a small fixed amplitude; zero horizontal travel or drift
CONTACTS: both mechanical feet remain planted and never slide throughout the strike and recovery

PHASE_00: exact neutral guard
PHASE_25: both hammer-arms draw backward together while knees and shoulder pistons compress slightly
PHASE_50: both hammer-palms swing forward and downward together into one symmetrical impact pose; torso braces without stepping
PHASE_75: both arms recoil upward and backward together while the torso rises toward guard
PHASE_100: exact PHASE_00
TRAJECTORIES: both hammer-palms follow matching forward-down impact arcs and matching recovery arcs; shoulder plates and forearm mass lag subtly; legs remain fixed; three amber lenses remain fixed to the chest
AMPLITUDE: large synchronized arm swing, small knee compression, small torso brace, no locomotion
TIMING: quick anticipation, decisive midpoint impact, smooth recovery; two identical complete strike cycles over the backend's four-second source so the first two seconds contain exactly one complete strike and recovery
PERSISTENCE: ceramic shell, all limbs, joints, brass fittings, chest lenses, feet, and hammer-palms remain present and structurally consistent throughout
